text:
jordan: FYI onboarding run for rankx-3b shows ndcg@10 down ~1.9% on curated holdout, but mrr@10 up ~0.9%. Suspect preprocessing.
mei: Which preprocessing changes landed?
jordan: We reduced snippet_len 256->192 and enabled the new URL-collapsing normalizer in the same PR.
rafa: Quick cohort check: long-docs ndcg -3.6%, short-queries ndcg +0.4%. Looks like context loss.
mei: Ran a small ablation locally. Command: `./bin/rankbench --model rankx-3b --split holdout_curated --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10`
eval-bot: queued ablation matrix (snippet=256/224/192, normalizer=old/new, quant=fp16/int8). run id rb-3456. ETA 20m.
rafa: While we wait, I diffed token lengths: median passage tok len fell by 18 tokens with the new normalizer+192.
eval-bot: results:
```
snippet=256 normalizer=old quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4293 mrr@10 0.2187
snippet=224 normalizer=old quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4258 mrr@10 0.2201
snippet=192 normalizer=old quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4210 mrr@10 0.2210
snippet=256 normalizer=new quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4269 mrr@10 0.2195
snippet=224 normalizer=new quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4230 mrr@10 0.2208
snippet=192 normalizer=new quant=fp16 -> ndcg@10 0.4184 mrr@10 0.2222
snippet=192 normalizer=new quant=int8  -> ndcg@10 0.4166 mrr@10 0.2235
```
mei: Pattern clear: both shorter snippets and the normalizer independently reduce ndcg; combined they are worst. int8 amplifies ndcg drop slightly while nudging mrr up.
jordan: Action items: 1) try snippet=224 as compromise and re-run focused long-doc slice. 2) add per-query churn CSV for >2 position shifts (rafa). 3) block canary until holdout_longdoc ndcg stable.
eval-bot: hold flag set for rankx-3b (reason: ndcg regression on holdout_longdoc >1%).
rafa: Uploaded churn csv and 30 example queries. I'll start the 224 long-doc run now.
mei: Also adding a note to onboarding checklist: always ablate snippet length + normalizer + quant before promoting.
jordan: Thanks — will follow up after 224 results.
